verdict.rationale: Fellow's Developer API is versioned by path (/api/v1, OpenAPI spec version 1.0.2), which covers the versioning half of the story. The same source says there is no published deprecation policy or API changelog, so the reliability-over-time half is unsupported. Missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, API changelog, sunset/notice timelines, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The API carries path versioning only (/api/v1, spec version 1.0.2)
